name: AI Webmaster Studio – AI Content, SEO & Website Builder, All-in-One.
author: aiwebmaster.cloud

sections.description:
Bring AI directly into WordPress with AI Webmaster Studio — a free AI-powered assistant for creating, improving and managing your website.

Use ChatGPT and AI-powered workflows to create pages and posts, expand or rewrite content, improve SEO and GEO, work with images and media, plan layouts, support internal linking, audit your website and build location-based directory content — all from your WordPress dashboard.

AI Webmaster Studio is designed for administrator-supervised work.
You decide when AI runs, what it can do and what gets published. Review AI-generated results before publication and keep control of your website.

Features:

  • AI-assisted page and post generation.
  • ChatGPT-powered content creation, rewriting, expansion and
    summarization.
  • SEO and GEO checks to help improve content for search engines and
    AI-powered discovery.
  • Administrator-triggered single and bulk content actions.
  • Site-wide Design System for Site Builder and visual improvement.
  • Content-preserving visual enhancement and duplicate H1 prevention.
  • Documentation, internal-link suggestions, audits and orphan
    detection.
  • Image generation and Media Library workflows.
  • Directory and map workflows for locations and partners.
  • AI Policies, task history and Undo where supported.
  • English source strings using native WordPress internationalization.

Administrator control

AI Webmaster Studio does not silently take over your website. The administrator starts, configures or approves tasks.

AI output may be incomplete or inaccurate. Review it before publication.
Regulated content requires qualified human review.

AI Webmaster Studio Operator is an optional identity for AI actions. It
is disabled by default and uses a visible non-Administrator role.

AI Webmaster Studio and AIWOS Cloud

AI Webmaster Studio is a complete free plugin. All features in this
package are available without an AIWOS Cloud account.

AIWOS Cloud is a separate future platform for autonomous website
operation. It is not required to use AI Webmaster Studio.

The AIWOS screen is informational. It does not automatically connect to
AIWOS Cloud, transmit site data to aiwebmaster.cloud or perform license
checks.

Donations

Donations are voluntary. They do not unlock features, licenses,
subscriptions or service tiers.

Source code and build

All shipped PHP, JavaScript and CSS is editable source with no minified
counterpart. Leaflet 1.9.4 is bundled locally under its BSD-2-Clause
license. Tests stay outside the production ZIP.

External Services

AI Webmaster Studio does not use telemetry, advertising trackers or
automatic license checks. It can contact the following services when the
related feature is configured or used.

OpenAI API

Service: OpenAI API, operated by OpenAI.

Purpose: AI-assisted generation, rewriting, summarization, planning,
documentation, internal-link support, layout planning and image
generation.

When data is sent: After an administrator saves their own key and starts
an AI task, connection test or supported bulk action. Activation alone
does not send website content.

Data that may be sent: Prompts; selected titles, excerpts and page/post
content; headings, links, site structure, project profile, goals, design
settings, directory context and generation settings. Tests may request
models and send a short prompt. Image generation sends a prompt and may
download the result.

Do not send credentials, payment data, confidential customer data or
protected information unless transmission is authorized and lawful.

OpenAI terms: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/

OpenAI privacy policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/

OpenAI API documentation: https://platform.openai.com/docs/

OpenStreetMap

Service: OpenStreetMap website and raster map tiles, operated within the
OpenStreetMap ecosystem.

Purpose: Display an optional directory map and provide links to
locations.

When data is sent: If an administrator publishes the map with
OpenStreetMap, the visitor’s browser requests map tiles. Clicking a
location link opens openstreetmap.org.

Data that may be sent: Requested tile coordinates, plus browser request
data such as IP address, user agent and referrer.

OpenStreetMap terms: https://osmfoundation.org/wiki/Terms_of_Use

OpenStreetMap privacy policy:
https://osmfoundation.org/wiki/Privacy_Policy

OpenStreetMap copyright: https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright

Google Maps JavaScript API

Service: Google Maps JavaScript API, operated by Google.

Purpose: Display an optional interactive directory map or open
destination directions after a visitor clicks a directions link.

When data is sent: Interactive maps load after an administrator selects
Google Maps and supplies a key. Directions open only after a visitor
clicks the link.

Data that may be sent: The browser API key, map settings and
coordinates, plus request data such as IP address, user agent, referrer
and applicable cookies.

Google Maps terms: https://maps.google.com/help/terms_maps/

Google privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Google Maps documentation:
https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/javascript

Apple Maps directions

Purpose: Open destination directions when the administrator selects
Apple Maps and a visitor clicks Get Directions.

Data that may be sent: Destination coordinates and browser request data.
The plugin does not request the visitor’s current location.

Apple Maps terms:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/maps/terms-en.html

Apple privacy policy: https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/

Project website links

Project links open aiwebmaster.cloud only after an administrator clicks
them. The plugin does not automatically send site content or telemetry
there.
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress, open Plugins > Add New Plugin and install AI Webmaster
    Studio.
  2. Activate the plugin and open AI Webmaster Studio > Getting Started.
  3. To use AI features, save your own OpenAI API key in Settings.
  4. Select a model and run the connection test, which contacts the
    OpenAI API.
  5. Review AI Policies and publishing settings.
  6. Start with a draft and review the result before using bulk actions.
  7. Configure a map provider only if you use the optional directory/map
    feature.

The plugin can be activated without an API key. AI text and image
operations require a valid key and may create charges in the
administrator’s OpenAI account.
sections.faq:
Is AI Webmaster Studio free?

Yes. All included features are available without an AIWOS Cloud account.
Donations are voluntary.

Do I need an AIWOS Cloud subscription?

No. AIWOS Cloud is a separate platform and is not required to use AI
Webmaster Studio.

Do I need an OpenAI API key?

Your own OpenAI API key is required for AI text and image features.
Other screens remain available without it.

What can I create with AI Webmaster Studio?

You can use AI-assisted workflows to create and improve pages and posts,
rewrite and expand content, work with images, perform SEO/GEO checks,
support internal linking, plan layouts and perform other
administrator-triggered website tasks.

What information is sent to OpenAI?

When an administrator starts an AI operation, selected prompts, context
and website content may be sent as described above.

Does AI Webmaster Studio change the site by itself?

No. This plugin does not include full Autopilot or unattended scheduled
website changes. The administrator starts, configures or approves tasks.

Should I publish generated legal or privacy content without review?

No. AI output is not legal advice. Use an appropriately qualified
reviewer for legal, privacy, security and compliance content.

Where can I get help?

See https://aiwebmaster.cloud/documentation/ and
https://aiwebmaster.cloud/support/. Never send private keys, passwords
or confidential data to support.
sections.changelog:
1.6.18

  • Makes the Directory Map Full width option work inside constrained
    WordPress block layouts.
  • Adds native alignfull and alignwide compatibility classes.
  • Prevents theme margin and maximum-width rules from overriding the
    selected map width.
  • Keeps full-width maps centered on the viewport without adding width
    through padding or borders.
  • Preserves the Leaflet renderer, synchronized markers, page content
    and saved map configuration.
